subject: Error modindices: non-numeric argument to binary operator

messages.author: 525431f717ee56c8
messages.subject: Error modindices: non-numeric argument to binary operator
parts:
Hi all,

currently I am facing the following error, while calculating modification indices: 

Error in lavTech(object, "inverted.information.expected") * nobs(object) : non-numeric argument to binary operator

The Model fits without any problems, even though fit measures could be better. As I would like to investigate how to improve my model, I would like to see modification indices.

I am looking forward for any recommendations. Thank you in advance.

My Syntax is:
model <- '
#Structural Model
y ~ a*lv1+b*lv2+c*lv3+d*lv4+e*lv5+g*lv6+x1+x2+m_lv2_x2
lv1 ~ k*lv4+l*lv5+m*lv6
lv2 ~ n*lv4+o*lv5+p*lv6
lv3 ~ q*lv4+r*lv5+s*lv6

#Measurement Model
y =~ y1+y2+y3
lv1 =~ x1lv1+x2lv1
lv2 =~ x1lv2+x2lv2
lv3 =~ x1lv3+x2lv3
lv4 =~ x1lv4+x2lv4+x3lv4+x4lv4
lv6 =~ x1lv6+x2lv6+x3lv6+x4lv6
lv5 =~ x1lv5+x2lv5+x3lv5
m_lv2_x2 =~ x1lv2.x2+x1lv2.x2

#Correlations
lv2 ~~ x2
lv2 ~~ 0*m_lv2_x2
x2 ~~ 0*m_lv2_x2

x1lv2.x2 ~~x1lv2.x2
'

fit <- sem(model=model, data=dat2, fixed.x=FALSE, std.lv=FALSE, std.ov = TRUE, orthogonal=FALSE, estimator="ML", missing = "fiml", test="default", se = "robust", meanstructure=TRUE)

modindices(fit, sort. = TRUE, maximum.number=50)
